newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly up on higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly up on higher volume.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed up by 0.03 percent in higher volume, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 487.19 points, up from 487.03 on Wednesday. Total volume was 1.87 million dinars against 991,928 dinars in the previous session.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia gained 0.48 dinar to 44.5 dinars and Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was up 0.48 dinar to 17.48.
L'Union Bancaire pour le Commerce et l'Industrie rose 0.46 dinar to 47.5 dinars, with Banque de l'Habitat advancing 0.26 dinar to 17.48. Amen Bank eased 0.12 dinar to 33.78 dinars.
Palm Beach Hotels gained 0.13 dinar to 10.8 dinars. Airline Tunis Air was up 0.1 dinar to 23.9 dinars with 5,223 shares changing hands.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was down 0.18 dinar to 11.82. ($1=1.08 dinar)
